SELECT i.ticker AS symbol, i.currency AS currency FROM instruments i WHERE i.ticker IN
#{symbol}

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, i.ticker AS symbol, i.currency AS instrumentCurrency, o.side AS side, o.quantity AS quantity, COALESCE(o.executed_price, o.price) AS fillPrice, o.fx_rate AS fxRate, COALESCE(o.executed_on, o.updated_at, o.created_at) AS executedAt FROM orders o INNER JOIN portfolio p ON p.portfolio_id = o.portfolio_id INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE p.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.status = 'FILLED' ORDER BY i.ticker, COALESCE(o.executed_on, o.updated_at, o.created_at), o.order_id

SELECT s.symbol AS symbol, s.last_price AS lastPrice, i.currency AS currency, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM market_quote_snapshots s INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.ticker = s.symbol WHERE s.symbol IN
#{symbol}
